scientific_review.question: 增加相邻立方体的公共面通量图，固定常向量场和相反外法向核对±1抵消，保留特殊机制与一般Gauss定理的论证边界。

facts.objects: two adjacent unit cubes sharing one square face
facts.projection: oblique drawing of three-dimensional cubes; affine display axes not physical metric scales
facts.role: shared interface cancels when summing subregion fluxes; not proof of general divergence theorem

scientific_review.basis: Analytic identities and domain checks; plotted finite windows do not replace proofs.

reader_review.caption: 两个相邻单位立方体共用绿色面，图用斜投影表示三维几何。取常场$F=(1,0,0)^\top$，共同面上两侧外法向为$n_1=(1,0,0)^\top$与$n_2=-n_1$，对应通量为$1,-1$，相加抵消。整体外向净通量也为零，与散度为零一致；一般区域的散度定理仍需要前述条件与证明。
